rows.label: Prop 19 New Taxable Value formula (family home, 100% transferred)
rows.value: Factored base year value + (full cash value − excluded amount), i.e., full cash value − $1,044,586 when value exceeds the cap
rows.notes: Excluded amount = factored base year value + $1M cap; excess is added to the base.

rows.label: Prop 19 applies to transfers by reason of death, including distributions from a trust
rows.notes: 'Transfer' includes transfers occurring due to death, whether within or outside a trust.

rows.label: Prop 19 family-home exclusion conditions
rows.value: Heir must make the home their principal residence and claim the homeowners' exemption (see BOE for filing windows)
rows.notes: Family home = dwelling eligible for homeowners' or disabled veterans' exemption from the transferor's ownership and occupancy. Rental homes are not eligible.

rows.label: Rental property is excluded from the Prop 19 parent-child exclusion
rows.notes: The third unit in Property B would be treated under the family-home definition; mixed-use treatment must be confirmed by the SF Assessor (flagged).
